title: Icon Cloud date: 2024 05 24 description: An interactive 3D tag cloud component author: dillionverma published: true Installation CLI Manual Copy and paste the following code into your project. With Images With SVG Icons Usage Props Prop Type Default Description icons React.ReactNode[] [] Array of icons to render in the cloud images string[] [] Array of image URLs to render in the cloud showControl boolean true Show play/pause control button Accessibility The cloud rotates automatically, so it ships with a play/pause control by default to satisfy WCAG 2.1 SC 2.2.2 (Pause, Stop, Hide). --- title: Icon Cloud date: 2024-05-24 description: An interactive 3D tag cloud component author: dillionverma published: true --- ## Installation CLI Manual ```bash npx shadcn@latest add @magicui/icon-cloud ``` Copy and paste the following code into your project. ## With Images ## With SVG Icons ## Usage ```tsx showLineNumbers import { IconCloud } from "@/components/ui/icon-cloud" ``` ```tsx showLineNumbers
``` ## Props | Prop | Type | Default | Description | | ------------- | ------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------ | | `icons` | `React.ReactNode[]` | `[]` | Array of icons to render in the cloud | | `images` | `string[]` | `[]` | Array of image URLs to render in the cloud | | `showControl` | `boolean` | `true` | Show play/pause control button | ## Accessibility The cloud rotates automatically, so it ships with a play/pause control by default to satisfy [WCAG 2.1 SC 2.2.2 (Pause, Stop, Hide)](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/pause-stop-hide.html). Rotation also pauses automatically when the user has `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` enabled. Setting `showControl={false}` removes the only way to resume it, so opt out only when your layout provides its own control.
